Name: Akaza NPC - Demon Slayer
Author: kArmag0re
Description:
[color=#a4457a][size=4][b]Mod features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=2]A new NPC and doesn’t replace any existing ones. The NPC is available for dating and marriage and can even have kids. The kids will take after his appearance.[/size]
[*][size=2]A new piece of furniture: a rug resembling Akaza's Compass Needle, which can be purchased.[/size]
[*][size=2]A new type of crop: Blue Spider Lily.[/size]
[/list]
[line]
[color=#A4457A][size=4][b]Bug report/Feature suggest/Translate the mod/Mod request or anything else[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2]If you're too shy to reach out to me directly or publicly, or you want to translate the mod, you can fill out the following form anonymously: [/size][url=https://forms.gle/5aBzeUjpxVgxuNBz6]Form[/url] 

[line]
[color=#A4457A][size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size][/color]
[list][size=2][*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download the mod.
[*]Unzip the folder.
[/size][*][size=2]Move the folder into the ‘Mods’ folder under the ‘Stardew Valley’ directory.[/size]
[/list]
[line]
[color=#A4457A][size=4][b]Mods Compatibility[/b][/size][/color][size=2]
The following list includes all the mods I have checked for compatibility upon request. If you don’t see a mod you like, it doesn’t necessarily mean it is incompatible, just that I haven’t checked it yet. If you want me to check for compatibility or if you experience any compatibility issues, please leave a comment under "Bugs" or in the normal comments.
[/size][list][size=2][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] Tested version: 1.15.8
[/size][/list]
[line]
[color=#A4457A][size=4][b]Compass Needle Rug[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2][b]Where to buy: [/b]Carpenter shop and Furniture Catalogue.
[b]Cost[/b]: 500.[/size]

[line]
[color=#A4457A][size=4][b]Blue Spider Lily[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2][b]Where to buy: [/b]Seeds shop.
[b]Availible: [/b]During fall.
[b]Cost[/b]: 5'000.
[b]Time: [/b]It takes it 15 days to grow.
[b]Earn: [/b]10'000.[/size]

[line]
[color=#A4457A][size=4][b]Schedule[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2]Akaza starts his day in the mines and only comes out depending on the sun's descent. The time he emerges varies by season:
[list][*]Spring = 19:00
[*]Summer = 19:30
[*]Fall = 18:30
[*]Winter = 17:00
[/list]When he emerges, he walks to the Forest and stops near the bushes around the lake.
The only time he leaves the mine before sunset is on rainy days. On those days, he goes out at 06:10.[/size]

[line]
[color=#A4457A][size=4][b]Gift preferences[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2]I do not recommend giving him anything food-related. He can’t eat human food, so he would see such a gift as an insult. 
[/size]Try giving him minerals :)

[line]
[color=#A4457A][size=4][b]Heart events[/b][/size][/color]
[quote][size=3][b]2 Heart Event[/b][/size]
Time: From when Akaza arrives to the forest till 10 minutes before midnight.
Location: Forest.
Friendship changes:
[spoiler]”What were you doing?” = +50
”Why are you in Pelican Town?” = +25
*Go away* = -50[/spoiler][size=2][/size][/quote]
[quote][size=3][b]4 Heart Event[/b][/size]
Time: 6:00 till Akaza leaves the Mine.
Location: Mine.
Requisites: 2 heart event seen.
Friendship changes:
[spoiler]”I’m gathering resources.” = +50
”Just bored.” = +75
"Why do you want to know?" = -75[/spoiler][/quote]
[quote][size=3][b]Fall event[/b][/size]
Time: 6:00 till Akaza leaves the Mine.
Location: Mine.
Requisites: 1 friendship heart.
Friendship changes: +25.
This events will give you a quest.[/quote]
